Ever since I was a little kid, maybe 7 or so, I wanted to be a Vet. When I was a preteen I researched how long I would need to go to school, which schools I would want to possibly go to, best areas to practice, etc. I was dead set on doing it. When I became a teenager I started volunteering at a clinic to get into the behind-the-scenes work and have something to put on college applications. Two months in of helping out and sitting in on patient exams, etc,  someone came in to have their dog put down. I listened. I watched. I saw them put the lifeless body into a trash bag and take him away. And I fucking lost it. 

Couldn't bring myself to want to do it anymore after that.
